title: Can You Watch the Atlantic Festival Fireworks From a Boat in Funchal?
description: Yes, from the bay, but only on a custom trip arranged on WhatsApp. The 2027 contest shows are on 5, 12 and 19 June, with Funchal's closing show on 26 June.
heroAlt: Fireworks bursting over Funchal harbour on a June night, reflected in the sea, small boats in silhouette
keywords: can you watch the Atlantic Festival fireworks from a boat

images.prompt: A warm June night in Funchal, Madeira, photographed from low on the water far out in the bay. Large gold, white and red fireworks burst above the harbour, their colours reflected in long streaks on the calm black sea. Behind them the lit city climbs the hillside, with the long harbour wall and a lit cruise terminal on the left. In the foreground, the dark silhouettes of three or four small boats at anchor with tiny navigation lights, people on them only as distant silhouettes. Realistic night photo, natural colours, no text.
images.alt: Fireworks bursting over Funchal harbour on a June night, reflected in the sea, small boats in silhouette
